scenes.text: A positive times a negative gives a negative; two negatives multiply to a positive.
Calculate 4 times (5). The answer is 20. Equal signs produce positive; different signs produce negative. Result: 20.
A number-line challenge in a craft workshop asks for the product of two signed numbers: -3 times (-7). What is the result? Pause to choose and explain.
